snippet.title: Trinity 64 Reveal Trailer || Monster Taming Direct 2025
snippet.description:
This trailer was made to show off the art style and atmosphere for my game Trinity 64.  It’s also meant to officially announce the type of genre it is.  This trailer was also made for the Monster Taming Direct hosted by @GymLeaderEd ! Trinity 64 is a Retro inspired Soulslike Monster Tamer inspired by games like Ocarina of Time, Elden Ring, and Spectrobes.  Trinity uses an N64 inspired visual style as well.

OST by @Tarro57 

Monster Taming Direct 2025:  https://youtu.be/Fe0pgU-LvDM?si=vheImuk-vHhYaJfD

Business Email:  bilsu64YT@gmail.com

- STEAM PAGE for Wishlists!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3802950/Trinity_64/

- PATREON for anyone who wants to support and see behind the scenes weekly devlogs!
https://www.patreon.com/Trinity64Game?utm_medium=unknown&utm_source=join_link&utm_campaign=creatorshare_creator&utm_content=copyLink

- DISCORD for anyone who wants to be a part of a small community around the game!
https://discord.gg/rb3gh5RuVy

Thanks so much for your support towards Trinity 64! :D

Music:  Twilight Symphony
